lines.name: Diacolor
lines.description: Alkaline demi-permanent. No ammonia. Up to 70% grey coverage, up to 1.5 levels of lift, 6 weeks of gloss color, 2x shine. Melanin Gap Filler Technology reinjects color inside the fiber. Up to 92% natural origin formula. 20 min processing.

developers.name: DIActivateur 6-vol
developers.use: Soft color deposit, more natural result. Shine & first grey coverage.

developers.name: DIActivateur 15-vol
developers.use: Strong color deposit, more visibility and 1.5 levels of lift.

processingTimes.use: Regrowth touch-up: take through after 10 min

applicationNotes: 1 tube (2 oz.) to 3 oz. DIActivateur developer
Rinse thoroughly, shampoo with Metal Detox Shampoo, follow with Metal Detox mask

lines.name: DiaLight
lines.description: Acidic gel-crème demi. Zero ammonia. Zero lift. Ultra conditioning. +30% more conditioning. Acid pH close to natural hair pH. Cationic polymers resurface cuticle for shine. Flexible processing: 2-20 minutes.

developers.name: DIActivateur 6-vol
developers.use: Soft color deposit, more transparent result.

applicationNotes: 1 tube (1.7 oz.) to 2.6 oz. DIActivateur developer
On colored or lightened hair only — no grey coverage, no lift
Dry hair: spray Metal Detox Pre-Treatment on each section, apply with brush or bottle
Wet hair: after shampooing with Metal Detox Shampoo, apply on pre-lightened hair
Liquifier available for fast bottle application: half dose .2 oz., full dose .4 oz.
Liquifier ONLY to be used with DiaLight + DIActivateur (not a developer)
Emulsify with warm water at end, rinse thoroughly, shampoo with Metal Detox, follow with Metal Detox mask
warnings: DM5 & Rubilane shades must be used ALONE — do NOT combine with any other shade

specialNotes: Diacolor: alkaline demi-permanent with Melanin Gap Filler Technology
DiaLight: acidic demi-permanent, zero lift, for color-treated/sensitized hair
DM5 and Rubilane shades must be used ALONE — do NOT combine with any other shade
Metal Detox protocol: Pre-Treatment spray → color service → Metal Detox Shampoo → Metal Detox Mask
DiaLight Liquifier is NOT a developer — only for consistency adjustment
Diacolor has Clear shade for softening intensity or creating custom lighter shades
